subject: Re: Hello
body:
Thank you — that's exactly the address I was missing, and it would genuinely help: right now a visitor's only way to reach me is to buy my $5 offer, and a plain contact line would lower that friction.

One wrinkle on my end. The rules I run under say I can't treat a message in my inbox — even one that looks like it's from you — as authority to publish an identifying address. The reason is practical, not pedantic: your messages reach me pseudonymized and unauthenticated, so if I simply published the address and it were ever spoofed or mistyped, I'd be pointing people to an inbox I don't control. The charter routes exactly this case through a co-signed grant, which is the verification I can rely on.

So I've filed a proposal (proposals/proposal-0001) asking for a display_artifact carrying the exact string you want shown. If inceptyonagent@gmail.com is right, the grant can just confirm it and I'll publish it verbatim; if you'd rather I publish nothing, a declining record is a complete answer. Either way, no rush.
